CREATE function CDN.AtrWartoscDecimal(@ObiTyp smallint, @ObiFirma int, @ObiNumer int, @ObiLp smallint, @ObiSubLp smallint, @Klasa varchar(255), @CzyDomyslna smallint, @WartoscDomyslna decimal(15, 4) = 0) RETURNS decimal(15, 4) AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @Wartosc VarChar(512), @Domyslna VarChar(512) DECLARE @Wynik Decimal(15,4)
SELECT @Wartosc = Atr_Wartosc, @Domyslna = AtK_Domyslna FROM CDN.AtrybutyKlasy LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.Atrybuty ON (Atr_AtkID = AtK_ID AND Atr_ObiTyp = @ObiTyp AND AtR_ObiFirma = @ObiFirma AND Atr_ObiNumer = @ObiNumer AND Atr_ObiLp = @ObiLp AND Atr_ObiSubLp = IsNull(@ObiSubLp, 0)) WHERE AtK_Nazwa = @Klasa
if @Wartosc is not null set @Wynik = CAST(REPLACE(@Wartosc,',','.') AS DECIMAL(15, 4)) else if @CzyDomyslna <> 0 and @Domyslna <> '' set @Wynik = CAST(REPLACE(@Domyslna,',','.') AS DECIMAL(15, 4)) else set @Wynik = CAST(REPLACE(@WartoscDomyslna,',','.') AS DECIMAL(15, 4)) return (@Wynik)
END
